name: Materializer follow-up four-arm confirmation
warmupRationale: Prospectively increased from five to eight after the diagnostic DENSE recording showed a transport releaseBatch C2 compilation 0.65 seconds into its first measured query. Main materializer methods had already reached C2 during warmup. Eight is fixed for every arm; no adaptive extensions or favorable-tail selection.
runtimeRule: Original immutable 127-entry classpath for original arms. Candidates replace only index1 LMDB production classes; other126 exact artifacts include the unchanged original harness/fixture/diagnostics and post-main root launcher.
rootAudit: Existing launcher reads absolute HOSTED_GENERIC after original main only. Require zero hosting and thirteen total semantic compiles, one per query. UNHOSTED_HARD_DECLINES is recorded but inert and supplies no independent proof.

statistics.primary: For each fresh JVM, median of all five measured query times and allocated bytes. Candidate/comparator ratio of those JVM medians within each matched round, then median and full range of four round ratios. No pooling with earlier protocols.
statistics.terminology: Matched-round ratios across separate JVMs; never within one shared JVM.
statistics.routeQualification: Preserve selection/tier frequency histograms. If histograms differ, retain data and qualify same-route cost claims; never discard a fork for a favorable estimate.

failurePolicy: Fresh output directories only. Preserve and stop on any invalid result, ledger endpoint leak, root host, unexpected coordinate refusal, input/JVM identity mismatch, process failure, or changed frozen artifact. No replacement or silent exclusion; no accepted aggregate when incomplete.
quietPeriod: No build/test/compiler/archive jobs or other application JVMs during serial timing. Root explicitly releases the period after candidate validations and runtime freeze.
nextStep: Run validate-only against this fixed protocol, then execute the sixteen prescribed fresh JVMs once. No outcome-driven protocol change or additional rounds.
orderDesign: Balanced four-arm Williams square: each arm occupies each position once; every ordered adjacent pair appears once; each comparison occurs in both relative orders.
preExecutionRevision: Before all timings, parent selected the Williams square in place of simple cyclic rotations; counts and estimands unchanged.

interpretation.consistentGain: Call a candidate latency improvement consistent within this bounded experiment only when all four matched-round candidate/comparator latency ratios are below 1, with valid checksums, matching observed route/tier histograms, preserved expected resolver-call behavior, and ledger ownership/cleanup invariants.
interpretation.uncertainty: Always report the median and full four-pair range. A range crossing 1 is inconclusive; it is neither evidence of equivalence nor a performance win. Four paired JVMs do not provide a broad statistical-confidence claim.
interpretation.callQualification: Compare measured resolver-call histograms for candidates using the same transport mode. OFF and DENSE have intentionally different expected call counts; their ablation is reported separately. Any unexpected call-count difference is retained and explained before claiming a localized CPU-cost effect.
interpretation.selection: Prefer the least complex variant with a consistent supported gain. Inconclusive candidates remain preserved experiments.
interpretation.fixedStoppingRule: No tail dropping, arm reruns, or extra rounds chosen from timing outcomes. All five measured queries are primary, and the four prescribed rounds are the complete protocol.

baselineMetadataCorrection: Before any comparison timing, corrected the baseline map reference to benchmark-source-hashes.json with exact file SHA34767935. Candidate1 uses superseding metadata; its source map and runtime bytes remain unchanged. Earlier descriptor/provenance and executed helper preimages are preserved.
quietPeriodRelease: Root explicitly released the timing window after matching94 and OFF84/CHANGES90/SELECTION90/ROWS90 passed, final generated build metadata restored, both candidate runtimes frozen, and no competing build/test/archive jobs remain.
